tactics:
induction x with
| nil => intro x_1; exact h1 x_1
| cons a as ih => intro x_1; unfold List.flatMapM.loop; exact h2 a as x_1 (fun bs' => ih (bs' :: x_1))
induction x <;> intro x_1 <;> simp only [List.flatMapM.loop] <;> simp_all
induction x <;> intro x_1 <;> unfold List.flatMapM.loop <;> simp_all
